entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of deals; an Orzhov cleric reveals a secret order within it to a visiting scribe.

entities.name: Deathpact
entities.description: A glass tube on a gold chain holding living white smoke, namesake of a sacred order within the Orzhov.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The ghost halls from which the angel claims to have come with a message.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: An Orzhov figure to whom the angel's message is addressed.

entities.name: Maze
entities.description: A maze that Teysa Karlov must find the correct route through and complete.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the guilds, including the Orzhov, live.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose wojek sacrifice themselves so innocents may live.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A Ravnican guild seen as appropriately selfless.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose chemical fire the scribe once witnessed.

events.summary: An Orzhov cleric tells a visiting scribe that his order is a gateway for life.
events.quote: "I am a gateway for life," the cleric said.

events.summary: The cleric invites the scribe to follow him to the sanctum.
The cleric shows the scribe the Deathpact, namesake of his order.
The cleric scatters handfuls of coins around himself as part of the ritual.
events.quote: reached in to scatter handfuls of coins around him on the floor

events.summary: The smoke of the Deathpact enters the cleric's nostrils and he crumples.
events.quote: the smoke lunged into the cleric's nostrils and vanished

events.summary: The cleric's body withers as a winged, scythe-bearing angel forms from the smoke, coins and gold.
events.quote: The cleric's body shriveled and desiccated before my eyes

events.summary: The angel orders the scribe to write down her message.
The angel delivers a message from the ghost halls of the Obzedat for Teysa Karlov.
events.quote: I have come from the ghost halls of the Obzedat with a message for Teysa Karlov.

events.summary: The angel says Teysa Karlov must complete the maze at all costs.
events.quote: Teysa Karlov must find the correct route and complete the maze at all costs.

relations.note: The Deathpact is the namesake of a sacred order within the Orzhov.
relations.quote: It is the namesake of our sacred order.
